payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

check.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
check.complete_when: The mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones.
check.partial_when: There is visible progress toward placing the mug to the right, but it is not clearly to the right.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the mug has not been moved toward the right of the headphones.
check.unknown_when: The relative positions or any progress cannot be determined confidently.

dependencies.evidence: Both objects are identifiable in the edited image: the mug is on the right and the headphones are near the center, so their relative positions can be compared.
